title: Check the other meanings before you use a word
summary: Read every gloss of a headword before writing, because the first one is often the trap.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: High-frequency Chinese words are short and busy, so a single English gloss misleads constantly. Before you trust a word in writing, read all its definitions and notice which part of speech each one belongs to; a meaning listed as a measure word, an interjection, or a surname will not fit your sentence. Then look at the example sentences and ask whether the sense you need appears there at all. If the entry only offers senses far from yours, you probably want a different word, not a different grammar.
